Layout (Layout (page 22)) Yan Wang is the second identity he created, and is also the only controller of the Hell Organization. The Hell Organization wanders in the gray area of the secular world, accepting capable people and strangers from all over the world. It handles secret disputes between all parties, suppresses evil spirits in the dark, and liquidates defectors. The intelligence network spreads all over the world, penetrating all walks of life, and its power is secretive and terrifying. On weekdays, Zhang Haoyu is gentle and calm, has a superior family background, and cultivates He is a high-level righteous monk who is the support of his family, the helmsman of the group, and an ordinary policeman at the railway police station. But when night falls and the lights of the courtyard fade away, Yan Wang's will will penetrate the entire hell organization. The organization's mission dispatch, personnel scheduling, power cleanup, intelligence gathering, and external enemy checks and balances are all secretly coordinated by his core subordinates, Pan Feng and others. , the dark forces that wander outside the law are all eliminated by the hell organization. One identity is based on the light, protecting relatives and friends. The other identity is hiding in the darkness, suppressing the filth of the world. Long Jiaying does not know all his secrets, and is not clear about his dual layout. He just silently accompanies and trusts him, takes care of worldly affairs, and spends time with his family and friends. Quiet, peaceful and peaceful. When necessary, Zhang Haoyu transforms into Yan Wang, takes charge of the hidden dangers in the dark, removes the scattered minions of the Demon Sect, and eliminates the dark forces hidden in the world. He knows very well that as long as the Demon Sect's ancestors die, the crisis will not disappear. He improves his cultivation and accumulation in the dark, and arranges forces and eliminates hidden dangers in the dark. The two lines work in parallel, and everything seems to be stable. On a day-to-day basis, Zhang Haoyu has already laid out a huge net. When the storm comes again, he can calmly deal with it, protect his family, maintain stability, and suppress the evil spirits. The days in the courtyard are still uneventful, and no one knows that in this ordinary courtyard, there is an unparalleled powerhouse who spans the secular world, the spiritual world, and the underground dark world. The morning light shines into the house through the wooden lattice windows of the courtyard, and Zhang Haoyu gets up early. There is still a thin layer of dew on the bluestone floor in the courtyard. Long Jiaying is doing morning exercises. Zhang Haoyu comes to the kitchen to prepare breakfast. The faint aroma of food wafts from the stove, losing the fierceness of the monks fighting, just looking normal. Looks like home. After breakfast, Zhang Haoyu packed the wild boars that had been packed in the space neatly into the trunk of the jeep. "The prey is ready, let's take it to the place." Let's go, Brother Xiaoyu! When the prey comes back, we should go to Xiangjiang for two days, otherwise the two little girls will have to worry about it again. Zhang Haoyu nodded and drove off. The jeep arrived at the police station in front of the station, and the colleagues rushed to help unload the wild boar from the jeep. In today's environment where meat is scarce, stable prey is important for any unit. It was crucial. On the way back, the two of them found a suitable place and put the jeep into the space. Zhang Haoyu took Long Jiaying's hand and teleported to the outside of the Xiangjiang Mid-Levels Villa. After a while, they came to the door of Villa No. 1 and took out the key to open the door. When the security personnel heard the noise, they immediately ran over and saw that it was Zhang Haoyu and Long Jiaying. They quickly said hello, Mr. Zhang, Miss Long...
